newsitem.title: UK: Euro straight-run fuel markets steady and quiet.
newsitem.headline: Euro straight-run fuel markets steady and quiet.

text.p: European straight-run fuel oil markets were quiet and steady on Friday, with no physical business seen done and supplies limited.
Prices held steady, with offers around the $100 fob mark and only two cargoes seen available later in the month. The last deal seen was around the $97 level on Tuesday.
Russian resid fuel supplies were also tight, but demand was poor, particularly in the Mediterranean. Discussion was lethargic, with many majors on holiday and traders gathered at an industry meeting.
